extras.real_size: three-masted galleon, hull 22 m, approx. 28.5 m with bowsprit, 27 m high
extras.notes: bow faces -Y, stands on its keel at z = 0 (waterline at about 2.6 m: teal boot stripe above the cream bottom); planked hull with teal sheer band, brass moulding and dark wales, two rows of gun ports with red lids in brass frames, high stern castle with quarterdeck, stern windows and quarter galleries glowing warm (emissive), stern gallery with brass balusters, big stern lantern (emissive flame), forecastle, long bowsprit with jib, carved brass scroll as figurehead, three masts with cambered square sails, tops, shrouds on channels and stays, capstan, gratings, barrels and ship's wheel; no flags, no skulls, no moving parts

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
